analysis.title: Vornado Realty Trust (VNO): 3Q26 First Take: Leasing economics improved in 3Q
key_insights: VNO reported 3Q26 Core FFOPS of $0.65, 0.3% above the GS estimate of $0.65 and 3.8% above the FactSet consensus of $0.63. The small variance vs GS came from offsetting items: somewhat lower consolidated rental revenues and lower operating expenses than expected, but higher JV income.
NY leasing volume was 526k SF, +28.6% q/q and -15.3% y/y. The y/y decline reflects a tough comp, since 3Q25 included 325k sqft of leasing at PENN 2.
NY office leasing spreads were +37.2% GAAP / +25.9% cash in 3Q26, vs +7.7% GAAP / +5.0% cash in 2Q26.
GS expects VNO could outperform on 11/3 given the beat vs consensus, the sequential rise in leasing volume and improving leasing economics. VNO does not give formal guidance.
Same-store NOI grew +9.0% GAAP / +3.2% cash y/y in 3Q26, vs +9.8% / +2.9% in 2Q26 and +7.5% / -8.2% in 3Q25.
VNO's share of NY leased office occupancy was 93.0%, +80bps from 92.2% in 2Q26 and +460bps from 88.4% in 3Q25.

Leasing spreads were positive for all regions on a GAAP basis and for all but NY retail on a cash basis. NY retail was +4.5% GAAP / -15.7% cash, 555 California +59.0% / +38.0%, and THE MART +12.6% / +7.7%.

NY office TIs and leasing commissions as a percent of initial rent fell 1.3 percentage points q/q to 12.0%. NY retail was 5.4%, THE MART 14.5% and 555 California 10.3%, all lower than FY25 (13.4% / 8.4% / 24.0% / 15.2% for NY office / NY retail / THE MART / 555 California).
VNO repurchased no shares in 3Q26. Through 9/30/26 it had bought back 4.53mn shares for $133.3mn at an average $29.41, about 16% below the current $34.97 price.

On 10/21/26 the 350 Park Ave JV closed (VNO/Rudin JV owns 40%, VNO owns 36.1%). The JV signed a 1.05mn sqft anchor lease with Citadel, leaving 850k SF to lease in the high-rise floors, and closed a $3.3bn construction loan.
On 10/26/26 the $48mn non-recourse mortgage on the 825 Seventh Ave condominium matured unpaid, a maturity default. GS will look for call commentary on plans for the property.
GS maintains a Sell rating with a 12-month price target of $31, based on a Q5-Q8 target AFFO multiple of 34.4x. That implies 11.4% downside from $34.97.

Key call questions: SS NOI and occupancy drivers, leasing pipeline and mark-to-market, cash NOI conversion as free rent burns off, capital needs at 350 Park, retention for 4Q26-2027 expirations, PENN 1 and PENN 2 cash-vs-GAAP gap, and non-core asset sales and near-term debt.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps its Sell and $31 target (11.4% downside from $34.97) despite a Core FFOPS beat and stronger leasing spreads, while saying VNO could outperform on 11/3 on the beat and improving leasing economics.

sector_views.rationale: NY office leasing spreads, occupancy and TIs improved in 3Q26, though quarterly leasing volume remains volatile.

earnings_insights: VNO 3Q26 Core FFOPS reported at $0.65 (reported 11/2/26 print), vs GS estimate $0.65 and FactSet consensus $0.63, a 0.3% beat vs GS and 3.8% vs consensus.
GS forecasts FFOPS of $0.65 for 12/26E (4Q26) and $0.64 for 3/27E, vs $0.74 reported in 6/26. FY FFOPS estimates are $2.42 for 2025, $2.53 for 2026E, $2.85 for 2027E and $3.20 for 2028E.
VNO gives no formal guidance. GS wants to know whether management's FY26 and FY27 FFO expectations changed after the 3Q results.
The earnings call is 11/3/26. GS says VNO could outperform on the beat, the sequential rise in leasing volume and improving leasing economics.
risk_factors: Upside risks to GS's Sell view: acceleration in the NYC office market (higher leasing spreads and economic occupancy), lower debt costs and greater office liquidity, higher and sooner development NOI, stronger disposition execution (lower cap rates), lower tenant improvements and maintenance capex, and accretive buybacks or acquisitions.
The 825 Seventh Ave condominium mortgage ($48mn) matured unpaid on 10/26/26, a maturity default.
Leasing volume and spreads are volatile quarter to quarter.
The stock trades about 16% above the average price VNO paid in its buyback.
cross_bank_references: SLG management noted on its 3Q26 earnings call that it had seen free rent declining.

tension_points.bull_case: VNO beat consensus Core FFOPS ($0.65 vs $0.63), leasing volume rose 28.6% q/q, NY office spreads reached +37.2% GAAP / +25.9% cash, and TIs fell, so GS expects VNO could outperform on 11/3.
tension_points.bear_case: GS keeps a Sell and $31 target, 11.4% below the $34.97 price. Leasing volume fell 15.3% y/y, NY retail cash spreads were -15.7%, and the 825 Seventh Ave mortgage is in maturity default.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Management commentary on the 11/3 call showing FY26/FY27 FFO expectations unchanged and TIs not sustaining their sequential decline would weaken the near-term bull case.
